scope: Reference profiles for ML.ENERGY V3 public GPU labels; not measured run-time hardware telemetry

unit_notes.peak_compute_*_dense_tflops: Per-GPU theoretical Tensor Core TFLOP/s with structured-sparsity uplift removed; a lower-bound denominator proxy, not achieved throughput.
unit_notes.hbm_bandwidth_gbps: Per-GPU theoretical GB/s (decimal), not observed bandwidth.
unit_notes.hbm_capacity_gb: Per-GPU vendor capacity in decimal GB.
unit_notes.rated_power_w: Maximum configurable TDP/TGP reference, not the run's configured power cap or observed power.
unit_notes.interconnect_bandwidth_gbps: Per-GPU bidirectional NVLink reference GB/s; no communication-time proxy is used without an auditable communication-volume model.
